purpose: Review one finite Campaign137 catalog against all 152 complete definitions and frozen terminal histories, rejecting rescue, source-proxy and post-exposure operator refreshes before any Campaign137 value is read.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_signed_or_directional_price_basis_adjustment_1d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Use the sign or separate up/down legs of log(factor_t/factor_p).
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign136 rejected signed direction before values, froze magnitude/higher as its only formula, and then failed the exact development trial. Reversing or splitting the sign now would be outcome-conditioned rescue.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_price_basis_adjustment_streak_recency_decay_or_threshold_event
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Aggregate nonzero adjustments over a recent window, use time since last adjustment, or threshold the magnitude into an event.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign136 explicitly rejected every streak, age, decay, tolerance and threshold variant before reading its source. Its terminal no-rescue rule forbids reopening those choices.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: inferred_corporate_action_type_from_factor_ratio_and_daily_close_return
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.source: Campaign136 factor ratio plus accepted daily price fields
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Infer dividend, split or other corporate-action classes from the adjustment ratio and raw price response.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The accepted basis source does not identify an official action type. Campaign136 rejected raw-close reconciliation and event classification; inferring labels from price fields would create an unverified source proxy and leak the terminal factor into a rescue branch.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_transaction_price_tail_spread_overlap_or_mad_resolution
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.source: accepted one-minute amount and volume snapshot
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Replace Campaign128's Q25/Q75 morning-afternoon IQR resolution with Q10/Q90, MAD, Wasserstein, overlap or another distribution distance.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign128 froze and terminalized the executed-price distribution-resolution mechanism, while Campaign129 explicitly rejected overlap and alternate distances. Changing quantiles, estimator or support is a post-result statistic sweep.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: price_basis_adjustment_confirmed_by_minute_attention_old_factor_or_complete_library_model
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.source: Campaign136 series plus the frozen historical feature library
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Interact, gate, weight or fit the terminal adjustment magnitude with minute attention, volume, old factors or a learned complete-library model.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign136 prohibited confirmation combinations before values, and Campaign132-134 terminalized nonlinear fits, calibrated consensus and correlation-component constructions. Conditioning a failed factor on exposed features is not a new information mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_gap_zero_volume_resumption_or_basis_adjustment_liquidity_proxy
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.source: accepted daily OHLCV and price-basis rows
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Use opening gaps, zero-volume streaks or adjustment-day liquidity to proxy resumption, tradability shock or hidden corporate-action state.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign113 capacity-terminalized suspension/resumption, and Campaign129/135 rejected daily zero-volume and opening-gap proxies. Adding the terminal basis series does not repair the missing official event semantics.

selection.reason: Every finite proposal is an explicit Campaign136 rejected branch, a terminal distribution/gap/source-proxy family, or a post-exposure combination/model rescue.

decision.next_campaign_requirement: Begin Campaign138 only from a genuinely new prevalue mechanism or separately accepted historically versioned point-in-time source; preserve all Campaign137 rejections, the exact 152-definition/141-comparator orders, and Candidate49 as the sole prospective ledger.
